# Mehdi Bahlaoui

> Personal website of Mehdi Bahlaoui, styled as a Wikipedia page. It hosts his biography, a collection of personal essays, original music with synced lyrics and annotations, and interactive experiments such as a 3D globe built with Rust/Bevy compiled to WebAssembly.

The site is a static HTML/CSS/JavaScript project with no build system. Articles and songs are rendered client-side from JavaScript data files, and individual pieces are addressed with URL hash fragments (e.g. `article.html#job`), so fetching a template URL without executing JavaScript returns the empty shell rather than the content. The raw content lives in `assets/js/articles-data.js` and `assets/js/music-data.js`.

## Pages

- [Biography](https://mehdibahlaoui.com/): Wikipedia-style profile — early life, work, interests, and personal lore
- [Written works](https://mehdibahlaoui.com/articles/): index of all essays and articles
- [Music](https://mehdibahlaoui.com/music/): track listing with a Genius-style player (synced lyrics + annotations)
- [Interactive globe](https://mehdibahlaoui.com/articles/globe.html): 3D globe experiment built with Rust and Bevy, running in the browser via WebAssembly
